item.title: New videos show Alex Pretti scuffle with federal officers in Minneapolis 11 days before his death
item.description: Alex Pretti was forcefully taken to the ground by federal immigration agents after kicking out the tail light of their vehicle during a Minneapolis protest 11 days before he was shot and killed.
